title: eval-harness: CI prompt-regression metrics integration and quality gating enhancements
author: Avery Chen
description: Motivation: improve CI integration between the eval-harness and the main CI to allow per-prompt regression checks and metric-based quality gating. This PR wires eval metrics into the CI runner, adds per-prompt thresholds (precision/recall/accuracy/fluency), and surfaces failures as actionable CI annotations; it also includes a lightweight fallback policy so failing prompts can be exempted temporarily by a triage label. Changes: new CI hook that gathers eval outputs and computes per-prompt metrics; thresholds/config pulled from eval-harness/metrics/thresholds.yaml; gating logic added to .github/workflows/eval-ci.yml to fail builds when critical prompts regress; a new CLI tool eval-harness/tools/ci_reporter.py to convert eval outputs into GitHub annotations; unit tests and integration test harness updates; docs for the gating workflow. Commits summary: Initial commit: add metrics integration hook; Add per-prompt thresholds and gating logic; Add ci_reporter tool and integration with GitHub actions; Fix flake in CI runner and handle rate limits; Add unit tests, docs, and changelog. Files changed (high-level): eval-harness/ci/hooks/prompt_regression.py - core gating logic and threshold checks; eval-harness/metrics/thresholds.yaml - default per-prompt thresholds and severity mappings; eval-harness/tools/ci_reporter.py - converts eval outputs to GitHub annotations; .github/workflows/eval-ci.yml - wire gating step and artifact upload; tests/eval/test_gating.py - unit tests for gating behavior; docs/eval/ci-gating.md - workflow and triage process. Testing and CI: initial run showed lint failure and one flaky integration test; fixed lint issues and added retry/backoff to integration harness; final CI: build: pass, unit tests: pass, integration: pass, lint: pass. Review conversation: "Samir Patel: LGTM overall, left one comment about threshold granularity and making the config overrideable per-repo.","Avery Chen: replied: updated thresholds.yaml to allow repo overrides via env var and added docs section describing override precedence.","Elena Rodriguez: requested: please add a small end-to-end smoke test that runs the gating step against a minimal prompt set; added tests/eval/test_gating.py to cover this case.","Jonas Müller: noted: consider making the CI annotations batched to avoid rate-limiting; implemented batching in ci_reporter and added rate-limit handling.","Samir Patel: approved","Elena Rodriguez: approved"
merge_commit_message: squash: eval-harness: CI prompt-regression metrics integration and quality gating enhancements
release_notes: Enhancements to eval-harness CI integration: per-prompt metric-based gating with configurable thresholds; new ci_reporter tool to annotate CI with failing prompt details; ability to override thresholds per-repo via env var; added tests and docs for triage process.
notes: Operational notes: On rollout, enable gating in a single repo with triage label enabled for two weeks; monitor eval_harness.gating.regressions metric and sls/eval-gating alert. Rollback: revert workflow change if widespread flakiness observed.
